name: Microsoft Power BI / Fabric (workspace roles)
status: PIM 100.142 (built, not live-proven): list / add / remove through the Power BI ADMIN api only (GetGroupUsersAsAdmin, AddUserAsAdmin, DeleteUserAsAdmin) -- the engine identity is never a member of a workspace.
permissionsNeeded: Entra directory role 'Fabric Administrator' for the engine identity (Initialize-PimWorkloadPrereqs.ps1 -Workload PowerBI -GrantFabricAdministrator)

Fabric tenant settings > Admin API settings: 'Service principals can access read-only admin APIs' and 'Service principals can access admin APIs used for updates' for a security group the engine identity is in
Fabric tenant settings > Developer settings: 'Service principals can call Fabric public APIs'

prerequisites.tokenAdapter: auth=powerbi -> token for https://analysis.windows.net/powerbi/api (the engine identity).
prerequisites.adminApiOnly: PIM 100.142: every call is a Power BI ADMIN api call (/v1.0/myorg/admin/groups/{workspace}/users). The admin api allows 200 requests per hour per tenant: one listing per workspace per run, and a 429 is waited out (Retry-After), never hammered.
prerequisites.scopeIsWorkspace: Row Scope = the Power BI workspace (group) id; the PIM group is added to that workspace with the access right named by RoleName.
prerequisites.rolesAreFixed: Power BI workspace roles are a fixed enum (no list API) -- declared as a static roles array below.
prerequisites.addOnly: Owner 2026-10-14 ('Keep refusing for now'): this release only ADDS. A Remove row is refused and reported exactly as before (no DELETE is ever made); removal comes after the add path is proven live.
